rationale: Estimated context limits per client, including AGENTS.md and expanded permanent instructions. Provider usage is reported separately.

hot.note: Ceiling for permanently loaded harness instructions, measured by client.

warm.note: Load only relevant procedures; move long references out of skill bodies.

cold.note: MCP tool catalogues travel with every request. Enable only the servers a workflow actually uses, and list in each agent only the tools it needs.

rules: alwaysApply true requires a written justification in the skill frontmatter
no timestamp, request id or generated header in the cached prefix
prefer one focused skill over a large one that activates on a broad glob
load the large reference on demand rather than inlining it in every turn
reuse evidence only for compatible content, command, configuration and environment
a problem that predates the change is a warn, never an extra round
use a connected token-saving MCP server such as cross-tk where it returns less than a whole read; never probe for one that is absent
fewer calls, smaller reads and shorter answers come before a cheaper model; each is a lever, and they compound
